title: Model Monitoring Config Compiler
description: Compiles model monitoring and drift detection configurations. Enforces baseline distribution capture, drift metric definition (PSI/KS/chi-squared), numeric alert thresholds, retraining triggers, data quality checks, and alerting integration.

error_codes.MM002: No baseline/reference distribution captured for drift comparison
error_codes.MM003: No drift metric defined (PSI, KS test, chi-squared, Jensen-Shannon divergence)
error_codes.MM004: No numeric alert threshold set for drift score
error_codes.MM006: No data quality checks (missing rate, range, type validation)
